views.createSql: CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT l.id AS id, h.id AS invoiceId, h.shopId AS shopId, h.invoiceNumber AS receiptNumber, h.buyerName AS buyerName, h.buyerPhone AS buyerPhone, h.partyId AS partyId, l.productId AS itemId, l.skuId AS variantId, l.itemNameSnapshot AS itemNameSnapshot, l.variantSummarySnapshot AS variantSummarySnapshot, l.qtyMilliUnits / 1000.0 AS quantitySold, l.qtyMilliUnits AS quantitySoldMilli, l.unitSnapshot AS unitSnapshot, l.unitCostPaise AS unitPurchasePricePaise, l.unitSellPaise AS unitSellingPricePaise, l.lineTotalPaise - l.lineProfitPaise AS totalCostPaise, l.lineTotalPaise AS totalRevenuePaise, l.lineProfitPaise AS totalProfitPaise, CASE WHEN l.lineTotalPaise - l.lineProfitPaise > 0 THEN l.lineProfitPaise * 100.0 / (l.lineTotalPaise - l.lineProfitPaise) ELSE 0.0 END AS gainMarkupPercent, CASE WHEN l.lineTotalPaise > 0 THEN l.lineProfitPaise * 100.0 / l.lineTotalPaise ELSE 0.0 END AS grossMarginPercent, h.paymentMode AS paymentMode, h.amountPaidPaise AS amountPaidPaise, h.balanceDuePaise AS balanceDuePaise, h.discountPaise AS discountPaise, h.cgstPaise + h.sgstPaise + h.igstPaise AS gstPaise, h.issuedAt AS soldAt, h.yearInt AS yearInt, h.monthInt AS monthInt, h.dayInt AS dayInt, COALESCE((SELECT -SUM(r.qtyMilliUnits) FROM invoice_lines r WHERE r.originalLineId = l.id), 0) AS returnedMilliUnits, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT -SUM(r2.qtyMilliUnits) FROM invoice_lines r2 WHERE r2.originalLineId = l.id), 0) >= l.qtyMilliUnits THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isReturned, l.lineTotalPaise + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r3.lineTotalPaise) FROM invoice_lines r3 WHERE r3.originalLineId = l.id), 0) AS netRevenuePaise, (l.lineTotalPaise - l.lineProfitPaise) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r4.lineTotalPaise - r4.lineProfitPaise) FROM invoice_lines r4 WHERE r4.originalLineId = l.id), 0) AS netCostPaise, l.lineProfitPaise + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r5.lineProfitPaise) FROM invoice_lines r5 WHERE r5.originalLineId = l.id), 0) AS netProfitPaise, h.issuedAt AS updatedAt FROM invoice_lines l INNER JOIN invoice_headers h ON h.id = l.invoiceId WHERE h.docType = 'SALE'
